customManagers.description: The dated OSS CAD Suite build. Its tags are dates (2026-11-05), so the dockerfile manager cannot see it; this manager updates the ARG in the Dockerfile and the PR build re-runs the version gate and the smoke regression.

packageRules.description: Monthly suite bump, never automerged: it changes every tool the image inherits from the suite (Icarus, SymbiYosys, GHDL, GTKWave), so the PR is a prompt to read the rebuild and the smoke result.
